
• Message notifications: when a contact sends you a message while Keyring is closed, you get a notification, and the message is fetched straight away when you tap it. (Opening that contact's chat directly from the notification is still being fixed.)
• While Keyring is open, an approval request from your agent now shows a banner. Messages don't, because they appear in the app.
• Keyring checks for new approval requests from all your agents each time you open the requests screen or tap an approval notification, including when that screen is already open.
• On an approval, "Show the full code" now looks like a button.
• A community's name now updates in Keyring after the community publishes or changes it.
• The test request card says only what actually happened, including when your agent let the request through without asking you.
• If the key Keyring uses to approve sign-ins is lost, Keyring sets it up again by itself.
• Known issue: "Share as a link" on the QR code screen doesn't connect yet; the receiving phone shows an error. Use the QR code for now. A fix is coming.
• Also includes everything in build 264.
